slam_boundary_timing_contract.inclusions: Nested intervals overlap; cannot add boundaries as exclusive total. CPU process includes OpenMP workers, DDS and writer threads; per-boundary process CPU is concurrent process activity, not exclusive function work. Thread CPU counts only current caller. Completion-window totals may include outer scopes whose start preceded window begin. Spin_some includes callback work and serialization/queueing; DDS work after return is outside synchronous publish wall. Logger enqueue/time itself not part of finished scope. No individual point payload allocation, no estimator state copy. Timer-disabled Scope only checks bool, performs no clock_gettime or row copy.
